note: Charts as a seed-declared manifest (item 2 refactor). `name` is the chart id; `tag` is the [a-z]+ control-character tag nu wraps every address in, hashed into SEED.lock; `behavior` selects the normalizer/classifier/segmenter, keyed by id in engine code. Adding a chart is a manifest row plus (if the behavior is new) three registered functions — no dispatch edit. The `correspondence` chart (added 2026-08-04) carries the base category's morphisms as CLAIMS: a correspondence is proposed through the one inlet like any other claim, addressed exactly, and the correspondence SET is derived from accepted claims — never written directly.
